description: Details of one template: names, what it is used for, tags, size, whether it is animated (then also how long the clip is) and its slots (the boxes where captions go). Each slot has fits_chars, about how many characters fit in it at a good size (0 is a small slot for a word or two): keep its caption under that or the text comes out small. With image: true (or show_slots: true) it also returns the picture with the slots outlined and numbered. Instead of template, give your own picture as image (base64) or image_url, as in create_meme: you get the slots found in that picture, the same ones create_meme uses with it.

image.description: true: also return the picture with the numbered slots. Or your own picture in base64 instead of template, as in create_meme

image_url.description: Your own picture instead of template: an https address the server downloads

show_slots.description: Also return the picture with the numbered slots, the same as image: true

template.description: Template id from search_templates, the same you give create_meme; or give image or image_url instead

name: get_template
